scope: Default activation selector clearing and settings remain unchanged.
Opt-in activation mode requires sparse-free-body parity plus diagnostic output and binds fixture base 1200 to activation control 1199; base zero is rejected.
Capture exact host input and targets, published MetalWorld scene output when present, runner host state, q/v result arrays, accepted-step counters and Matter snapshots.
Missing published scene readback and missing Matter after snapshot are represented as unknown/unavailable, not inferred from host state.
Raw MTLBuffer is unavailable from the public StepResult API; metadata states that the captured scene output is the published result vector.
Shipping probe selector behavior remains governed by its existing authored all-controls environment setting.
No physical operator, kernel, acceptance criterion, tolerance or native qualification change.
